purpose: Analyze date-related data to understand trends and patterns across different periods.
audience: Management and analysts who need insights into temporal data distribution.

kpis.name: Total Records
kpis.limitations: Counts all records, including duplicates if not properly filtered.

kpis.name: Unique Dates
kpis.limitations: Counts distinct dates, but may not reflect actual unique events if multiple records share the same date.

kpis.name: Distinct Months
kpis.limitations: Counts distinct months, but does not account for the number of records per month.

kpis.name: Distinct Years
kpis.limitations: Counts distinct years, but does not account for the number of records per year.

kpis.name: Distinct Quarters
kpis.limitations: Counts distinct quarters, but does not account for the number of records per quarter.

kpis.name: Records in March 2569
kpis.formula: COUNT(*) WHERE _month_th = 'มีนาคม' AND _year_be = '2569'
kpis.limitations: Counts records in March 2569, but does not account for other months or years.

kpis.name: Records in First Quarter 2569
kpis.limitations: Counts records in the first quarter of 2569, but does not account for other quarters or years.

kpis.name: Records in January to March 2569
kpis.formula: COUNT(*) WHERE _year_be = '2569' AND (_month_th = 'มกราคม' OR _month_th = 'กุมภาพันธ์' OR _month_th = 'มีนาคม')
kpis.limitations: Counts records in January to March 2569, but does not account for other months or years.

charts.title: Monthly Distribution of Records
charts.limitations: Counts records per month, but does not account for other dimensions.

charts.title: Yearly Distribution of Records
charts.limitations: Counts records per year, but does not account for other dimensions.

charts.title: Quarterly Distribution of Records
charts.limitations: Counts records per quarter, but does not account for other dimensions.

charts.title: Records in March 2569 by Year
charts.limitations: Counts records in March by year, but does not account for other months or years.

charts.title: Records in First Quarter 2569 by Year
charts.limitations: Counts records in the first quarter by year, but does not account for other quarters or years.

charts.title: Records in January to March 2569 by Year
charts.formula: COUNT(*) WHERE (_month_th = 'มกราคม' OR _month_th = 'กุมภาพันธ์' OR _month_th = 'มีนาคม')
charts.limitations: Counts records in January to March by year, but does not account for other months or years.

insight_questions: What is the distribution of records across different months?
How many records were recorded in March 2569?
What is the trend in record counts over time?
Which quarter had the highest number of records?
